description: Route code vectors. Normalise: upper-case ASCII a-z, remove U+0020 U+0009 U+000A U+000D and '-'. Then: length != 8 -> bad_format/length; a character outside the alphabet -> bad_format/confusable if it is one of O 0 I 1 L U, else bad_format/char (first offending character decides); wrong Luhn mod 30 check -> bad_check.

singleCharTypos.description: Every substitution of one character of each sample by another alphabet character; every one must fail with bad_check.

adjacentTranspositions.description: Swaps of two neighbouring different characters. Luhn mod 30 misses some of them; `result` is what a correct implementation returns.
